title: embedding
instructions: A tool call that creates something is answered with the nearest few existing entities of its kind, each a `hit` whose `near` names the new one. When one of them is the same thing, keep the one that stands: update it, and delete the new one.

vector_check.title: Check the vector index
vector_check.description: Check embedding configuration and the vector search engine. Reports missing embedding configuration, a missing vector table, an unavailable native scan on shared storage, or mixed model spaces requiring the ordinary vector reader. Takes no arguments and changes no records.
